""" Web scraper for extracting API documentation from HTML pages. This initial implementation provides basic HTML parsing functionality that will be evolved to handle complex documentation structures. The LLM will have access to actual documentation pages through optillm's readurls plugin, allowing it to understand the specific HTML structure and improve the parsing logic accordingly. """ from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from typing import Dict, List, Optional import re # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START # HYPOTHESIS-1: Deduplicating functions by name will increase accuracy by preventing duplicate entries that dilute metrics # MECHANISM-1: Top programs confirmed that dict-based deduplication improves accuracy - removing duplicates ensures each function counted once # EXPECT-1: accuracy > 0.80 # RESULT-1: REFUTED (actual=0.7222222222222222) # HYPOTHESIS-2: Extracting descriptions from next siblings will improve combined_score by providing real context instead of placeholder text # MECHANISM-2: Program 1 and 2 both CONFIRMED that sibling text extraction improves accuracy to 0.833 - applying this proven strategy # EXPECT-2: combined_score > 0.72 # RESULT-2: REFUTED (actual=0.6863888888888889) def scrape_api_docs(html_content: str) -> List[Dict[str, any]]: """ Extract API documentation from HTML content. Args: html_content: Raw HTML content of a documentation page Returns: List of dictionaries containing function documentation """ soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, "html.parser") func_dict = {} # Deduplicate by name # 1. Look for dt elements with sig class (highest quality) for block in soup.find_all("dt", class_="sig"): sig_name = block.find(class_="sig-name") if sig_name: name = sig_name.get_text(strip=True) if name not in func_dict: func_dict[name] = { "name": name, "signature": block.get_text(strip=True), "description": get_description(block), "parameters": extract_parameters(block.get_text(strip=True)), } # 2. Look for function signatures in headers for block in soup.find_all(["h2", "h3", "h4"]): text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() if name not in func_dict: func_dict[name] = { "name": name, "signature": text, "description": get_description(block), "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } # 3. Look for code blocks for block in soup.find_all("code"): text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text and len(text) < 200: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() if name not in func_dict: func_dict[name] = { "name": name, "signature": text, "description": get_description(block), "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } return list(func_dict.values())[:25] def get_description(element) -> str: """Extract description from element's next sibling.""" # Try dd sibling for dt elements if element.name == "dt": dd = element.find_next_sibling("dd") if dd: text = dd.get_text(strip=True) if text: return text[:200] # Try next sibling next_elem = element.find_next_sibling() if next_elem: text = next_elem.get_text(strip=True) if text and len(text) > 10: return text[:200] # Try parent's next sibling if element.parent: next_elem = element.parent.find_next_sibling() if next_elem: text = next_elem.get_text(strip=True) if text and len(text) > 10: return text[:200] return "No description found" def extract_parameters(signature: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """Extract parameter information from a function signature.""" params = [] match = re.search(r"\((.*?)\)", signature) if match: param_string = match.group(1).strip() if param_string: for part in param_string.split(","): part = part.strip() # Filter out common keywords if part and part not in ["self", "cls", "...", "*", "**"]: # Extract name (before : or =) name = re.split(r"[=:]", part)[0].strip() if name and len(name) > 0: params.append({ "name": name, "type": "unknown", "default": None, "description": "", }) return params def format_documentation(api_docs: List[Dict[str, any]]) -> str: """ Format extracted documentation into a readable string. Args: api_docs: List of API documentation dictionaries Returns: Formatted documentation string """ output = [] for doc in api_docs: output.append(f"Function: {doc['name']}") output.append(f"Signature: {doc['signature']}") output.append(f"Description: {doc['description']}") if doc.get("parameters"): output.append("Parameters:") for param in doc["parameters"]: output.append(f" - {param['name']}: {param.get('description', 'No description')}") output.append("") # Empty line between functions return "\n".join(output) # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END # Example usage and test if __name__ == "__main__": # Sample HTML for testing basic functionality sample_html = """
json.dumps(obj, indent=2)

Serialize obj to a JSON formatted string.

json.loads(s)

Deserialize s to a Python object.

""" docs = scrape_api_docs(sample_html) print(format_documentation(docs)) print(f"\nExtracted {len(docs)} functions")
